pages.text: The spell replicates the power of the Ocean Monument's Guardians whereupon it projects a laser towards any non-allied creature you're directly looking it that will damage them after a while. Unfortunately, much like the Guardians, the laser will stop once direct sight is broken.
Casting with $(l:crafts/staff/abyss_staff)Abyss Staff$() increases the spell's base damage by one heart.
